verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents an automatic audit trail covering all work in the product, and it positions the platform as keeping every decision defensible across agents and the human team. Case data and comments can be exported by time frame. However, the evidence never explicitly shows timestamps on audit entries, a way to retrieve or export the audit log itself, or that automated decisions are logged separately from human ones. Missing for 10: explicit timestamped audit-log entries, a documented audit-trail retrieval or export mechanism, explicit logging of automated decisions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions

citations.quote: Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
